title: Policy-as-Prompt: Rethinking Content Moderation in the Age of Large Language Models
reasoning: The paper examines the implementation of content moderation policies—which are fundamentally ethical and value-based frameworks—into LLM prompts. It empirically evaluates how LLMs handle categories like 'Hate' and 'Harm,' specifically mentioning religious protected characteristics and contextual ethical reasoning as part of the moderation process.
